conflicts.label: Iran 2026 (Day 73)
conflicts.note: Operation Epic Fury — Day 73 (May 11, Monday). DIPLOMATIC RUPTURE: Trump in Oval Office presser 12:51 ET called ceasefire 'on life support,' 'unbelievably weak,' Iran reply 'garbage,' 'didn't even finish reading it' — converts six days of Pakistan-channel shuttle diplomacy into a public rupture. NO new US/Israeli strikes on Iranian territory or shipping reported May 10-11 — 3rd consecutive day with zero new kinetic activity on Iran front despite peak rhetorical escalation. Project Freedom REMAINS PAUSED-BUT-CLEARED with no Pentagon restart announcement by May 11 22:00 UTC; Boxer ARG ETA slipped one week to week of May 18 per TWZ. Cumulative blockade tally REAFFIRMED (CENTCOM May 10 tweet): 20+ US warships enforcing, 61 commercial vessels redirected (vs. 57 at Day 70), 4 tankers disabled (vs. 3 at Day 70). GULF DRONE PULSE (May 10): Iran-attributed UAVs across UAE (2 intercepted, direct attribution), Kuwait (multiple hostile drones at dawn, no attribution), and Qatar (M/V Neha US-owned bulker struck 23nm NE of Doha, no casualties) — most geographically dispersed single-day Gulf attack pattern since early May. KHARG OIL SLICK: Windward AI confirms SECOND slick (12-20 km²) detected May 10; primary slick 52-71 km² persistent per Windward + Orbital EOS SAR — drifting south toward Qatar/UAE EEZ; UN warns of potential 'environmental catastrophe.' SAUDI MFA + GCC condemned 'in strongest terms' the 'treacherous targeting' of UAE/Qatar/Kuwait. SAUDI ARAMCO Q1 2026 net profit $32.04B (+25% YoY); CEO Nasser: market losing ~100M bbl/week. LEBANON: MoPH refreshed cumulative to 2,869 killed since Mar 2 (+86 vs Day 71); 74 killed in last 3 days; ≥103 medical workers killed cumulative (UN); IDF evacuation orders for Deir al-Zahrani, Jarjouh, Sajjad (Jezzine district); third round US-mediated Israel-Lebanon talks confirmed for Washington May 14-15. Iran Deputy FM Gharibabadi warned UK/France of 'decisive and immediate response' if warships deploy to Hormuz. Pakistan Army Chief Munir reaffirmed continued mediation. Trump expected to press Xi on Iran during May 14-15 Beijing visit. MARKETS: Brent $104.21 (+2.88%); WTI $98.07 (+2.78%) — both >40% above Feb 28 baseline. AAA national gas $4.520 (-0.2¢ d/d, 4th consecutive daily decline despite crude spike). S&P 500 intraday fresh ATH 7,426.35 (band 7,415-7,425 close pending); VIX 18.12 (+0.93). Defense modestly bid (LMT +0.57%, RTX +1.46%) — NOT a war-rally. Yardeni raised year-end SPX target 7,700 → 8,250. U.S. KIA 15 (carry-forward); WIA 415; cumulative cost midpoint $60.21B (Pentagon $25.8B / CBS-leak $51.5B / Popular Info $86.4B spread widening — gap now $60.6B vs $59.8B at Day 71). USS Gerald R. Ford Day 322 deployed (post-Vietnam record; trailing only Coral Sea 329 / Midway 332). Day 73 places this conflict 30 days past Desert Storm (43 days), 5 days short of Allied Force / Kosovo (78 days), and 6.08× longer than the June 2025 Iran-Israel war (12 days).

conflicts.label: Iraq 2003 (43-day major combat phase)
conflicts.note: Operation Iraqi Freedom — major combat phase (Mar 19 – May 1, 2003, ~43 days). Targets ~19,948 munitions / ~41,000 sorties. US KIA 139 in major combat phase (full OIF 2003-2011 KIA: ~4,431). Cost figure reflects major-combat phase only (~$25B nominal, inflation-adjusted to 2026 $). Full-conflict cumulative (2003-2011) is materially larger at ~$815B nominal / >$1.3T 2026 dollars.

conflicts.label: Libya 2011 (222-day Unified Protector)
conflicts.note: Operation Odyssey Dawn → Unified Protector — NATO no-fly zone (Mar 19 – Oct 31, 2011 = 222 days). NATO total ~26,500 sorties; US strike contribution ~700–1,000 targets (limited US role after handover to NATO Mar 31). US KIA: 0. US cost: ~$1.1B nominal / ~$1.5B 2026 dollars over 222 days = ~$7M/day average.

conflicts.label: Gulf 1991 (43-day Desert Storm air campaign)
conflicts.note: Operation Desert Storm — 38-day air campaign (Jan 17 – Feb 23, 1991) + 100-hour ground war (Feb 24 – Feb 28). ~118,000 coalition sorties, ~38,000+ targets engaged. US KIA: 148 hostile + ~235 non-hostile = ~383 total US deaths during operation. Cost: $61.1B nominal (CRS RL33110); inflation-adjusted to ~$135B in 2026 dollars over 43 days = ~$3.1B/day. 700,000 coalition troops deployed.

conflicts.label: Kosovo 1999 (78-day Allied Force)
conflicts.note: Operation Allied Force — NATO air campaign over Yugoslavia (Mar 24 – Jun 10, 1999 = 78 days). ~38,000 sorties. US KIA: 2 (Apache helicopter crash, training accident in Albania). Cost: ~$3B nominal / ~$5.6B 2026 dollars over 78 days = ~$72M/day average. NATO no-fly zone enforcement + strikes on Yugoslav targets to halt Kosovo operations.

sources: Comparison conflicts use FULL-CONFLICT TOTALS (not Day-21 snapshots). Sources: CRS R44116 (Iraq), RL33110 (Gulf War), R41725 (Libya), RL30374 (Kosovo). Costs inflation-adjusted to 2026 dollars using BLS CPI-U. APPROXIMATIONS: Sortie-counts vs. distinct-target-counts are not always cleanly separable in DoD records; figures cited are best-available open-source estimates and should be read as orders of magnitude. Iraq 2003 cost row reflects ~43-day major combat phase only — full OIF 2003-2011 totals are materially higher (~$815B nominal). Libya 2011 'targets_struck' reflects US strike contribution only (NATO total sorties ~26,500). Iran 2026 row is current state at Day 73 (in progress) and will be updated daily until ceasefire is formalized.
